title: Undergraduate & Graduate Positions EOI
content_text:
Expression of interest for Graduate/Undergraduate positions at Georgiou 
 You’re currently studying or ready for a Graduate position and finally ready to get the hands-on experience your tutors keep talking about. But how do you find a company you want to work with? A company passionate about sustainable change and long-term growth for their people. A company where you genuinely align with their values and aren’t just a number. And of course, a company delivering some epic projects around Australia. 
So, if you’re a young gun passionate about making transformational change in the construction industry, and you’re looking for a company that constantly ignites your love for construction while providing you the support and hands-on experience you need to thrive in your career, we would love to hear from you! 
 Why You’ll Love Working Here
 At Georgiou, now proudly part of STRABAG SE, one of Europe’s largest construction technology groups, you’ll join a business where local expertise meets global opportunity. For nearly 50 years, we’ve built Australia’s infrastructure and our reputation for being the best people to work with.
With Georgiou’s local knowledge and experience and STRABAG’s forward-thinking innovation, we’re delivering projects that connect communities, develop people, and set new industry benchmarks, all while staying true to the culture and values that make Georgiou unique.
- Build impact that lasts – work on iconic projects shaping Australian communities.
- Grow without limits – access world-class training, mentoring, and career pathways across Australia and STRABAG’s global network.
- Flexibility that works for you – enjoy wellbeing leave, paid parental leave, and support to help you stay connected to life beyond work.
- Belong and be supported – inclusive facilities like free hygiene products, parental and prayer rooms, and wellbeing programs.
- A culture that cares – our values of Care, Integrity, and Excellence guide everything we do.
- Reward for your work – competitive packages, annual reviews, and access to the Georgiou Perks discounts platform.
About you:
- Tertiary Qualifications in Civil Engineering, Environmental Science, HSEQ, Construction Management or related disciplines
- Be outcome focused with efficient communication, organisational and problem-solving skills
- A passion for civil construction and exposure so construction work would be highly advantageous but no necessary 
- Be someone who takes pride and ownership of their work with a willingness to learn and take on more responsibility as you develop 
- An excellent attitude and awareness for safety, attention to detail and quality 
 You will be trusted to: 
- Develop technical and non-technical skills, improve industry knowledge and best practice and experience varied aspects of the Engineering, Project Management, and Tendering functions 
- Assists with the management of planning, coordinating and controlling professional activities relating to projects. Including general planning, providing technical input and maintaining/updating contractual schedule/ program 
- Assists the management team in contract management activities, including tender’s specifications preparation, collaborating in subcontractor negotiation and supply agreement 
- Complete predetermined competencies within the allotted timeframe in order to progress through the Graduate Development Program 
Our best offer:
- Australian owned and CCF multiple award-winning national business with a strong pipeline of upcoming projects and opportunities for career development
- Access to Georgiou Perks platform providing discounts to a multitude of retailers
- Supportive leadership teams who care for and mentor you to achieve your full potential
- Values-led organisation guided by care, integrity and excellence in everything we do
- Growing business with exciting career development opportunities
Georgiou are committed to an inclusive workforce and welcome applications of candidates from culturally diverse backgrounds, people with disabilities, people who identify as LGBTIQ+ and people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent.
 Please visit our website for more information www.georgiou.com.au and apply via the link or through our website. We look forward to receiving your application!
 Georgiou is a proud equal opportunity employer and WGEA Pay Equity Ambassador.
apply_instructions: Apply online via the Georgiou Cornerstone (csod) career site requisition 2259 ('Apply' button at https://georgiou.csod.com/ux/ats/careersite/4/home/requisition/2259?c=georgiou) or through www.georgiou.com.au careers. Advert says: 'apply via the link or through our website.'
